newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia appoints new ambassador to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Australia appoints new ambassador to Indonesia.

text.p: Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer on Thursday named Australia's current ambassador to the United States, John McCarthy, as ambassador to Indonesia.
McCarthy replaces Allan Taylor, who has held the Jakarta post since April 1993, and ends months of searching after Australia's former nominee for the post, career diplomat Miles Kupa, withdrew.
"The government regards the relationship with Indonesia as of fundamental importance," Downer said in a statement.

Relations between the two countries soured in 1995 when Canberra rejected Indonesia's choice of its new ambassador to Australia, Lieutenant-General Herman Mantiri, because of controversial remarks over the 1991 Dili massacre in East Timor.
Kupa withdrew himself from nomination for the Jakarta post earlier this year after controversy about comments he had made several years ago about the business interests of President Suharto.
